property_summary: For any state and any caller, withdrawAll() never reverts when the caller has zero credit, because the reference C skips the withdrawal entirely; the mutant always attempts the call and reverts when the zero-value call's callee reverts (or the credit-transfer path fails).
change_summary: Replace the condition `if (oCredit > 0)` with `if (true)` so withdrawal attempts with zero credit now decrement balance and make a zero-value call, reverting on underflow when balance is 0.
